title: Prove FinetuneGate rejects worse detection candidates
task: Add regression tests that verify FinetuneGate evaluates detection outputs, maps class ids to label names, gates on person_precision and accuracy, and refuses a synthetically worse candidate.
acceptance: A fake current model and fake candidate model are evaluated through detection-style predictions, not classification probs.
The test fails if labels are compared as numeric class ids instead of names.
The test fails if a candidate with worse person_precision can be marked improved.
The test proves the candidate is not promoted when gate verdict is negative.
serial_reason: Safety boundary must be proven before scheduler or promotion work.

title: Fix FinetuneGate detection evaluation and gate metrics
task: Update FinetuneGate so evaluation uses detector outputs, maps cls indices to names, requires person_precision and accuracy improvement with epsilon, preserves previous model, and never promotes on failed comparison.
acceptance: FinetuneGate no longer reads classification-only probs for detection eval.
Metric verdict includes person_precision and accuracy.
Worse candidate returns a negative verdict and leaves active model unchanged.
Previous model path or marker is retained for rollback.

title: Make model promotion atomic and rollbackable
task: Replace unlink/copy promotion with an atomic file or pointer swap that is safe on Windows when possible, records previous active model, and writes a rollback marker.
acceptance: No code path unlinks the active model before the replacement is ready.
Promotion writes an auditable previous-model or rollback marker.
A simulated promotion failure leaves the original active model readable.
serial_reason: Must follow gate correctness and precede auto-promotion paths.

title: Add EmptySceneSampler triggers to CropCollector
task: Extend CropCollector with an EmptySceneSampler that captures true-negative frames by timer, no-detection threshold, and scene-memory background_only signal while suppressing capture when person or animal is detected.
acceptance: Timer trigger can save an empty frame after configured interval.
No-detection frame threshold can save an empty frame.
Scene-memory background_only can save an empty frame.
Any person or animal detection blocks empty-frame capture.

title: Persist empty/background metadata schema
task: Store empty negatives under runs/labels/<cam>/ with sample_type=empty_negative, storage-only class_name background or empty, timestamp, camera_id, frame_hash, trigger_reason, and source detections snapshot.
acceptance: Written metadata contains all required fields.
Frame hash is stable for identical image content.
Storage class_name does not imply a YOLO object class.
serial_reason: Uses sampler output schema from previous atom.

title: Capture hard negatives with provenance
task: Add hard_negative sample_type for false positives, rejected detections, and Gemini-relabeled background or other where live model fired person or animal.
acceptance: Hard-negative records use sample_type=hard_negative.
Metadata keeps the original model detection and rejection or relabel reason.
Hard negatives are distinguishable from ordinary empty negatives in manifests.
serial_reason: Shares CropCollector metadata paths with empty negatives.

title: Export empty scenes as empty YOLO label files
task: Update DatasetExporter so empty_negative and hard_negative background examples become image files with empty YOLO label files and do not add a background class to names.
acceptance: Negative samples produce image plus existing empty label file.
names and nc are backward compatible and contain no background object class.
Exporter manifest reports positive, empty_negative, and hard_negative counts.
serial_reason: Requires metadata fields from collection atoms.

title: Add deterministic dataset balancing policy
task: Add a policy-driven DatasetExporter balancer with max_empty_ratio, max_hard_negative_ratio, min_positive_count or equivalent ratios, deterministic seeded sampling, and a count manifest.
acceptance: Fixed seed produces the same selected sample ids across runs.
Configured ratios cap empty and hard-negative counts.
Manifest logs raw and selected counts by sample_type.

title: Guard Gemini training-time labels
task: Add Gemini labeling safeguards for training-time data: confidence threshold, abstention/agreement handling, human spot-check sample manifest, and hard exclusion from held-out eval.
acceptance: Low-confidence Gemini labels are abstained, not accepted silently.
Disagreements are surfaced for spot-check or hard-negative handling.
Held-out eval export rejects Gemini-labeled samples.

title: Add NightlyTrainingScheduler CLI and phase order
task: Create a CLI-driven NightlyTrainingScheduler that runs discover due days, lock, snapshot, Gemini labeling, YOLO export, train, evaluate, gate verdict, notify, and release lock in order.
acceptance: CLI entrypoint can run the scheduler in dry-run mode.
Phases execute in the documented order.
Lock is released on success and on handled failure.
Artifacts are written under a per-run directory.
serial_reason: Integrates gate, export, labeling, and training phases.

title: Add run ledger and missed-night catch-up
task: Implement per-date marker directories and STATUS files with PENDING, TRAINED, PROMOTED, ROLLED_BACK, and DRYRUN states; track manifest hash, artifacts, verdict, dry_run, resume, skip, and catch-up behavior.
acceptance: Completed dates are skipped idempotently for the same manifest hash.
Missed nights are discovered and queued.
Incomplete dates are resumed or safely skipped according to terminal status.
Ledger records dry_run flag and gate verdict.
serial_reason: Scheduler must exist before ledger integration is meaningful.

title: Add GPU inference lock for training
task: Implement a GPU/inference lockfile acquired before training and always released, with stale-lock detection scoped to nightly training.
acceptance: Lock acquisition blocks concurrent training runs.
Release happens on normal completion and handled exceptions.
Stale locks are reported with age and owner metadata.

title: Pause or degrade live inference during training
task: Add a clearly timed live-inference pause or degraded mode controlled by the GPU guard, with status and Telegram notification hooks.
acceptance: Live inference can enter and leave degraded or paused mode with a timeout.
Status includes mode, reason, start time, and expected deadline.
Notification hook receives start and finish events.
serial_reason: Depends on lock semantics and affects live service behavior.

title: Abort and rollback when nightly window is exceeded
task: Add a night-window watchdog for the 01:00-06:00 window that aborts training, releases locks, and triggers rollback handling when the window is exceeded.
acceptance: Watchdog reports inside-window and outside-window states deterministically with injected time.
Outside-window abort path marks the run rolled back or failed without promotion.
GPU/inference lock is released on watchdog abort.

title: Default first real training to dry-run without auto-promotion
task: Wire scheduler defaults so the first real train+compare run prints and notifies before/after metrics and gate verdict with auto_promote=false until operator confirmation.
acceptance: Default configuration has dry_run=true and auto_promote=false.
Dry-run performs train and compare but does not change active model.
Notification payload contains before metrics, after metrics, and gate verdict.
Auto-promote can only be enabled by explicit config change after operator review.
serial_reason: Final guard after scheduler, lock, watchdog, and gate are proven.

title: Choose external trigger mechanism for nightly OKO run
task: Document and implement the chosen trigger mechanism: bridge nightly hook or Windows Scheduled Task. Keep the trigger as a thin wrapper around the scheduler CLI.
acceptance: Operator or architect decision is recorded before implementation.
Trigger invokes the scheduler CLI in dry-run mode by default.
Docs include how to disable the trigger and where logs are stored.
serial_reason: Open operator decision; implement only after scheduler CLI exists.
